messages.content: I’ll lock in a DA arbitrage position: discharge during the morning and evening peaks, recharge in the cheaper midday hours, and charge again at the late-night negative prices. I’ll start with that physical schedule, then reassess at each watch.

The morning and evening DA trades have settled, with $917.84 earned so far. The battery has used its full discharge allowance. I’m retaining the late-night charging schedule; moving it earlier would depend on an uncertain RT price forecast.
